information: This is a multi-location FMC competition recognized by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional FMC Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2024. The following states are eligible for the title of Southern FMC Champion: - Arkansas - Louisiana - Mississippi - Oklahoma - Texas Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernFMCChampionship2024#39771-locations) for more information about the locations. For a more normal competition experience, check out [CubingUSA Southern Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024). This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaXRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9214a2ac7e84e29122d156f866079e025ede2826/image.png)
